## What changed

Describe the user-visible behaviour and the reason for the change.

## How it was tested

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] Fresh launch
- [ ] Control-screen URL change with screen sharing enabled
- [ ] Reset one screen, when relevant
- [ ] Standard and Multiple IP behaviour, when relevant

## Safety and privacy

- [ ] No credentials, cookies, tokens, logs, or private browsing data are included.
- [ ] Sensitive-action exclusions remain intact or the change explains why they are unaffected.
